entities.name: Adéla Bruns
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adéla Bruns, née Sýkorová is a Czech sport shooter. She competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics and in both the Women's 10 metre air rifle and Women's 50 metre rifle three positions events at the 2012 Summer Olympics. In the latter event, she won the bronze medal.
